title: Prospective held-out three-seed routing run
body: Regenerate the hash-checked Zero files, encode training through the Solomon byte adapter, train seeds 1, 2, and 3 for exactly four epochs, freeze every model hash, create ID-and-input-only blinded promotion rows, predict once per frozen model, and verify all seeds. The derived family_gate_ppm is 1000000 only when every seed reaches 900000 overall ppm, every seed-class pair reaches 800000 ppm, and all-seed agreement reaches 950000 ppm; otherwise it is zero.
claims: The promotion outcome is opened only after this design, both forecasts, both funding records, and the executable ilXyr registration merge.
The run happens once; training-only liveness evidence is excluded from the outcome.
Raw overall, per-class, and agreement metrics remain reportable beside the derived conjunctive gate.
